description.plain: Scenario B, resolved (RESOLVED 2026-10-05, no longer an open question): once the buyer is identified and resolved, the representation transitions contract_only -> buyer_specific + price. This is the selected working design: contract_only remains a genuinely unpriced state describing the caller who has not established entitlement; the Business resolves pricing for the recognized buyer via buyer_specific + price.
Entitled buyer sees their contract price; mode transitions to buyer_specific.
